task.text:
[0] Worms, cultured on axenic medium, showed a prolonged lifespan (axenic dietary restriction (ADR). Neuronal knockdown of cbp-1 (CREBBP ortholog) completely blocks ADR-induced lifespan extension. Progeny production was avoided by the addition of 5-fluoro-2′-deoxyuridine at 50 µM

[1] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the lifespan of worms on a limited diet. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[2] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the life-extending effect of daf-2 (IGF1R) knockout in worms on a restricted diet. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[3] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the life-extending effect of glp-1 (NOTCH) mutation in worms. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[4] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the life-extending effect of clk-1 (COQ7) mutation in worms. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[5] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown decreased the life-extending effect of mev-1 (SDHC) mutation in worms. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[6] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown canceled the mrps5 knockdown-mediated lifespan extension. mrps5 knockdown also increased the worm's resistance to P. aeruginosa through mild mitochondrial stress mechanisms, cbp-1 RNAi abolished this effect.

[7] cbp-1 (CREBBP) knockdown canceled the cco-1 knockdown-mediated lifespan extension. cco-1 knockdown increased the worm's resistance to P. aeruginosa through mild mitochondrial stress mechanisms, cbp-1 RNAi abolished this effect.

[8] Knockdown of cbp-1 (CREBBP) decreased the lifespan of worms. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

[9] The life span of male and female hamsters from three genotypes (wild-type, heterozygous, and homozygous tau mutants) was recorded in constant darkness. Male and female homozygous mutant hamsters lived significantly longer rather than shorter compared to wild-types.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
